blurb: Warm paper, a large serif and hairline rules: a considered, publication-grade voice.

direction.name: Editorial Paper
direction.thesis: The page reads like a well-set publication: one oversized serif headline, generous margins, hairline rules and a single burnt-orange accent used sparingly.
direction.grid: 12-column grid with wide outer margins; headline spans nine columns; supporting text sits on a narrower measure aligned to the grid, never centred.
direction.hero: Type-led: an oversized serif headline with the last line in italic accent, a hairline rule, then a three-part row (label, lede, action). A giant outlined wordmark crops off the bottom edge.
direction.imagery: Photography or illustration used large, full-bleed to a column edge, one per section, with a caption. No icon sets, no gradients.
direction.motion: Text and rules reveal with a short fade and a 12px rise, once. Nothing loops.
direction.voice: Measured and specific, written in full sentences. Dates, names and numbers instead of adjectives.
direction.signature: The cropped outlined wordmark along the bottom edge of the first screen.
